title.hi: Internet Protocols — TCP/IP se HTTPS Tak

subtext.hi: Protocols wo rules hain jo decide karte hain ki data kaise bheja aur receive kiya jaaye.
subtext.en: Protocols are the rules that decide how data is sent and received.

text.hi: Socho do log alag-alag languages bolte hain — communication tabhi possible hai jab dono ek common language use karein. Computers ke liye ye common language 'protocols' hain — fixed rules jo har computer follow karta hai taaki data sahi se transfer ho sake, chahe wo kisi bhi brand ya operating system ka ho.
text.en: Imagine two people speaking different languages — communication is only possible if both use a common language. For computers, this common language is 'protocols' — fixed rules every computer follows so data transfers correctly, regardless of brand or operating system.

content.hi: Protocol: Rules ka ek set jo decide karta hai ki network par data kaise format, transmit, aur receive hoga.
content.en: Protocol: A set of rules that determines how data is formatted, transmitted, and received over a network.

content.hi: TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol / Internet Protocol): Internet ka foundation protocol. IP data ko chote 'packets' mein todkar sahi address tak route karta hai; TCP ensure karta hai ki sab packets sahi order mein, bina error ke pahunchein.
content.en: TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol / Internet Protocol): The foundational protocol of the internet. IP breaks data into small 'packets' and routes them to the correct address; TCP ensures all packets arrive in the right order, without errors.

content.hi: Email Protocols — SMTP aur POP3: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) email SEND karne ke liye use hota hai. POP3 (Post Office Protocol v3) email RECEIVE/download karne ke liye use hota hai apne device par.
content.en: Email Protocols — SMTP and POP3: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used to SEND email. POP3 (Post Office Protocol v3) is used to RECEIVE/download email onto your device.

content.hi: HTTP aur HTTPS: HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol) webpages ko browser tak transfer karta hai. HTTPS wahi hai, bas 'S' (Secure) — data encrypted hota hai, isliye banking/login jaisi sensitive sites HTTPS use karti hain.
content.en: HTTP and HTTPS: HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol) transfers webpages to your browser. HTTPS is the same, but with 'S' (Secure) — data is encrypted, which is why banking/login sites use HTTPS.

content.hi: Remote Login aur File Transfer Protocols: SSH (Secure Shell) — kisi doosre computer ko securely remotely control karne ke liye. TELNET — purana, unencrypted remote login protocol. FTP (File Transfer Protocol) — files transfer karne ke liye. SFTP — Secure FTP (encrypted). SCP (Secure Copy Protocol) — files ko securely copy karne ke liye do computers ke beech.
content.en: Remote Login and File Transfer Protocols: SSH (Secure Shell) — for securely controlling another computer remotely. TELNET — an older, unencrypted remote login protocol. FTP (File Transfer Protocol) — for transferring files. SFTP — Secure FTP (encrypted). SCP (Secure Copy Protocol) — for securely copying files between two computers.

explanation.content:
Email: SMTP = send | POP3 = receive
Web: HTTP = transfer webpages | HTTPS = secure version
Remote/File: SSH = secure remote login | TELNET = old/unencrypted login
FTP = file transfer | SFTP = secure FTP | SCP = secure file copy

problem.hi: Ek company apne server tak securely remote access chahti hai, aur ek doosri purani school lab mein basic (non-secure) remote login use hoti hai. Konsa protocol kaunsa use karega?
problem.en: A company wants secure remote access to its server, while an older school lab uses basic (non-secure) remote login. Which protocol does each use?

steps.hi: Company ko security chahiye → SSH (Secure Shell) use karegi
steps.en: The company needs security → will use SSH (Secure Shell)

steps.hi: Purani school lab (basic, non-secure) → TELNET use karegi
steps.en: The old school lab (basic, non-secure) → will use TELNET

problem.hi: Ek bank ki website 'https://' se shuru hoti hai, jabki ek simple blog 'http://' se. Iska practical difference kya hai?
problem.en: A bank's website starts with 'https://', while a simple blog starts with 'http://'. What's the practical difference?

steps.hi: 'https://' matlab data encrypted hai — koi beech mein data intercept nahi kar sakta (jaise password, card details)
steps.en: 'https://' means data is encrypted — no one can intercept the data in transit (like passwords, card details)

steps.hi: 'http://' matlab data unencrypted hai — sensitive data ke liye risky hai
steps.en: 'http://' means data is unencrypted — risky for sensitive data

steps.hi: Isliye banks HTTPS mandatory use karte hain, simple info blogs kabhi-kabhi HTTP bhi use kar lete hain
steps.en: That's why banks mandatorily use HTTPS, while simple info blogs sometimes still use HTTP

question.hi: Email SEND karne ke liye kaunsa protocol use hota hai?
question.en: Which protocol is used to SEND email?

explanation.hi: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) email send karne ke liye use hota hai; POP3 receive karne ke liye.
explanation.en: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used to send email; POP3 is used to receive it.

question.hi: HTTPS, HTTP se kaise alag hai?
question.en: How is HTTPS different from HTTP?

options.hi: HTTPS sirf images ke liye hai

explanation.hi: HTTPS mein data encrypted hokar transfer hota hai — isliye sensitive info (login, banking) ke liye safe hai.
explanation.en: In HTTPS, data is transferred encrypted — making it safe for sensitive info (login, banking).

question.hi: TCP/IP mein IP data ko packets mein todta hai, TCP unhe sahi order mein pahunchana ensure karta hai.
question.en: In TCP/IP, IP breaks data into packets, and TCP ensures they arrive in the correct order.

explanation.hi: Sahi — IP addressing/routing sambhalta hai, TCP reliable, ordered delivery ensure karta hai.
explanation.en: Correct — IP handles addressing/routing, TCP ensures reliable, ordered delivery.

notes.hi: TCP/IP = internet ka foundation protocol (packets + reliable delivery)
notes.en: TCP/IP = the internet's foundation protocol (packets + reliable delivery)

summary.hi: Protocols wo common rules hain jo data transfer ko standard banate hain — email (SMTP/POP3), web (HTTP/HTTPS), aur remote/file transfer (SSH/TELNET/FTP/SFTP/SCP) ke apne-apne dedicated protocols hain.
summary.en: Protocols are the common rules that standardize data transfer — email (SMTP/POP3), web (HTTP/HTTPS), and remote/file transfer (SSH/TELNET/FTP/SFTP/SCP) each have their own dedicated protocols.
